name: UOB Lady's Solitaire Card

S$5 = Up to 25X UNI$ (equivalent to 10 miles per S$1) on Two Categories of Choice

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st and 2nd Supplementary Cards free, $196.20 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The UOB Lady's Solitaire Card is best for those who concentrate their spending in up to two chosen categories, maximizing UNI$ earnings (equivalent to 10 miles per S$1). The flexibility to change categories quarterly is a real plus, aligning rewards with evolving spending habits. Consider pairing it with a UOB One Account for potentially boosted UNI$. However, the high interest rates and various fees (especially the S$100 late payment fee) demand disciplined repayment habits. This card rewards strategic spending, not impulsive purchases.
our_takes.good-for:
Individuals who maximise rewards by strategically spending within preferred categories like fashion or beauty.
Cardholders aiming to accumulate UNI$ points and air miles through daily spending on dining and entertainment.
Professionals who enjoy the flexibility to change rewards categories quarterly, aligning with evolving spending habits.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Missed payments incur S$100 fees and 27.8% interest, potentially increasing to 30.8%, so pay on time.
Foreign transaction fees add 3.25% to non-SGD and 1% to SGD transactions processed abroad.
Cash advances come with an 8% fee (minimum S$15) plus 28.5% annual interest, making them costly.
